comment: * Provides built-in framework level Scroll Capture support for standard scrolling Views.

variables.name: DEBUG_VERBOSE
variables.comment: Log all investigated views, as well as heuristic checks

variables.name: TYPE_SCROLLING
variables.comment: * Slides a single child view using mScrollX/mScrollY.

variables.name: TYPE_RECYCLING
variables.comment:
* Slides child views through the viewport by translating their layout positions with {@link
     * View#offsetTopAndBottom(int)}. Manages Child view lifecycle, creating as needed and
     * binding views to data from an adapter. Views are reused whenever possible.

variables.name: TYPE_OPAQUE
variables.comment: * Unknown scrollable view with no child views (or not a subclass of ViewGroup).

methods.name: private static int detectScrollingType(View view)
methods.comment:
* Performs tests on the given View and determines: * 1. If scrolling is possible * 2. What mechanisms are used for scrolling. *

* This needs to be fast and not alloc memory. It's called on everything in the tree not marked * as excluded during scroll capture search.

methods.name: public ScrollCaptureCallback requestCallback(View view, Rect localVisibleRect, Point positionInWindow)
methods.comment:
* Creates a scroll capture callback for the given view if possible.
     *
     * @param view             the view to capture
     * @param localVisibleRect the visible area of the given view in local coordinates, as supplied
     *                         by the view parent
     * @param positionInWindow the offset of localVisibleRect within the window
     * @return a new callback or null if the View isn't supported

methods.name: static String resolveId(Context context, int id)

methodNames: public ScrollCaptureCallback requestCallback(View view, Rect localVisibleRect, Point positionInWindow)
